title: JSON-safe IntentTask and broadcast provider promotion
minimumPromotionPolicy: IntentTask/broadcast promotion requires a JSON-safe provider implementation, connected-device registration and trigger evidence, packaged manifest synthesis, exported receiver policy, bounded trigger payload validation, owner cleanup, denial matrix coverage, user-visible disclosure, rollback, Safe downgrade, security, TypeScript declarations, migration docs, and release sync before tasks.broadcast can be exposed.

entryRules: entry path must be project-relative or working-directory-relative
absolute paths, NUL bytes, .. segments, symlink escapes, and realpath escapes are denied before persistence
backend accepts embedded only until another launch backend has evidence
descriptorContract.idPolicy: opaque Node broadcast task ids cannot alias legacy Rhino IntentTask ids or packaged ids from another package identity

triggerPayloadContract.receiverThreadPolicy: receiver validates, snapshots, enqueues, and returns without running Node on the receiver thread
triggerPayloadContract.rateLimitPolicy: per descriptor cooldown and maximum pending executions are required before promotion

readyEvidence.meaning: P14-20 reserves JSON-safe broadcast descriptors, manifest synthesis rules, trigger payload snapshots, and owner-scoped remove cleanup without exposing tasks.broadcast.
P15-14 keeps packaged task scheduling unpromoted and preserves package-identity task ownership blockers before broadcast rows can be promoted.
The intent_broadcast provider remains provider_poc until implementation, device, packaged, disclosure, rollback, security, type, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial evidence all pass.
The intent_broadcast provider declares disable flags, diagnostics, disclosure fields, packaged downgrade behavior, and Safe downgrade requirements.
P15-15 owns P14-20 under pro.tasks_device_media with provider_manifest_archive evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Live JSON-safe provider evidence for register, list, get, enable, disable, remove, and validateManifestPatch without raw Android broadcast objects.
Manifest synthesis evidence for packaged opt-in receivers, boot permission, package data scheme, non-exported defaults, and deterministic patch reports.
Exported receiver denial/default evidence plus allowlist, permission, abuse-review, and Android 12/15+ matrix proof for any exported receiver promotion.
Trigger payload serialization evidence proving bounded JSON snapshots, privacy filtering, no raw Intent/Bundle/Uri handles, and receiver-thread non-execution.
Remove/disable evidence proving owned descriptor cleanup, dynamic receiver unregister, pending execution cancellation, packaged patch cleanup, and legacy Rhino row preservation.
P15-16 packaged install, trigger, remove, relaunch, metadata mismatch, undeclared capability, and rollback archive.
Cross-package descriptor mutation and receiver cleanup denial evidence for main-app, packaged, and legacy Rhino rows.
Provider-disable Safe downgrade proof that package-owned receivers are removed or disabled and broadcast trigger authority is denied.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before IntentTask/broadcast promotion can be marked promoted.
